text: I have labored much in sciences and languages, and I have up to now devoted forty years after I first learned the Alphabetum; and I was always studious. Indeed, when I was living in the other state of life , people marveled that I survived the abundance of my work. And still, I was just as involved in studies afterwards, as I had been before.
